bbmp_onyx: jangle_engine.cpp and engine.h from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/retro, commit 19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged
(GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX line in each file, COPYING). Onyx Music Files (.omf), the songs of the music disk "Jangle" by Onyx (MS-DOS, 1993): a
clean-room converter (from a description of the format only) to a 31-sample module that libopenmpt plays (Selecta's vendored copy, BSD 3-clause,
linked statically into the module; bbmp docs/replayers.md, engine `onyx`). Only these two files of csrc/retro are vendored; the helper functions
of retro:: (register_engine, text conversion, field) are in plugins/replayers/bbmp_onyx/shim.cpp. BBMP_ONYX_NODITHER (engine test hook) turns
libopenmpt's dither off.
